name: Panoptic Neural Fields
definition: An object-aware neural scene representation that decomposes a dynamic 3D scene into a set of objects (things) and background (stuff), each represented by a separate MLP-based neural function. It predicts a panoptic-radiance field representing color, density, instance, and category label of any 3D point at any given time.
summary: Panoptic Neural Fields is a neural scene representation that decomposes dynamic 3D scenes into distinct moving objects and static backgrounds using separate instance-specific MLPs, avoiding latent code bottlenecks.
